text:
Predicates:
PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
AttendsSchoolEvents(x) ::: x attends school events.
Engaged(x) ::: x is very engaged with school events.
PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ∨ ¬ActiveMember(x) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive and disinterested members.
ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) ::: x chaperones high school dances.
AttendsSchool(x) ::: x attends the school.
InactiveMember(x) ::: x is inactive and disinterested member of the community.
YoungChildOrTeen(x) ::: x is a young child or teenager.
WishesToFurtherCareer(x) ::: x wishes to further their academic career.
Student(x) ::: x is a student who attends the school.
Attends(x) ∧ Engaged(x) ∧ Student(x) ::: Bonnie either attends and is very engaged with school events and is a student who attends the school, or neither attends and is very engaged nor a student who attends the school.

Premises:
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) → AttendsSchoolEvents(x) ∧ Engaged(x)) ::: If people perform in school talent shows often, then they attend and are very engaged with school events.
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ∨ ¬ActiveMember(x)) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive and disinterested members of their community.
∀x (ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) → ¬AttendsSchool(x)) ::: If people chaperone high school dances, then they are not students who attend the school.
∀x (InactiveMember(x) → ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x)) ::: All people who are inactive and disinterested members of their community chaperone high school dances.
∀x (YoungChildOrTeen(x) ∧ WishesToFurtherCareer(x) → Student(x)) ::: All young children and teenagers who wish to further their academic careers and educational opportunities are students who attend the school.
BonnieAttends ∧ BonnieEngaged ∧ StudentBonnie ∨ ¬(BonnieAttends ∧ BonnieEngaged) ∧ ¬StudentBonnie ::: Bonnie either both attends and is very engaged with school events and is a student who attends the school, or she neither attends and is very engaged with school events nor is a student who attends the school.

Conclusion:
(YoungChildOrTeen(Bonnie) ∧ WishesToFurtherCareer(Bonnie) ∧ ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(Bonnie)) ∨ (¬YoungChildOrTeen(Bonnie) ∧ ¬WishesToFurtherCareer(Bonnie)) → (Student(Bonnie) ∨ ¬InactiveMember(Bonnie)) ::: If Bonnie is either both a young child or teenager who wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities and chaperones high school dances or neither is a young child nor teenager who wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities, then Bonnie is either a student who attends the school or is an inactive and disinterested member of the community.
